description: SARS-CoV-2 concentrations measured in NYC Wastewater is a dataset listed in City of New York open data portal (data.cityofnewyork.us), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of New York. Results of sampling to determine the SARS-CoV-2 N gene levels in NYC DEP Wastewater Resource Recovery Facility (WRRF) influent, disaggregated by the WRRF where the sample was collected, date sample was collected, and date sample was tested. Coverage: New York City. The portal files it under the category Health. Its tags are covid-19, coronavirus, wastewater based epidemiology, wastewater, sars-cov-2. The table has 9 columns. Attribution on the portal: Department of Health and Mental Hygiene. The portal shows 2026-08-03 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-cityofnewyork-us-portal.
